Name: Traveling Cart Tweaked
Author: Ice3ICE3
Description:
[b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]

Each time the Traveling Merchant (pig cart) visits, the following additional items will be added to the existing inventory:

- Bundles required items: From all unlocked but incomplete collections, select items you haven't submitted yet, following the original Traveling Merchant's listing limits, and randomly select up to 10 additional items to list.

- Stardrop Tea: Always available, 75% chance of 1 cup, 25% chance of 5 cups.

Once all Bundles are completed, only Stardrop Tea will be listed.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]

1. Install SMAPI (https://smapi.io)

2. Download this mod and extract it to the Stardew Valley/Mods folder

3. Launch the game

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]

- Smart Filtering: Only items from incomplete Bundles in unlocked areas that haven't been submitted will be listed.

- Vanilla Compliance: Items must pass the Traveling Merchant's own filtering criteria to be selected.

- Precise Demand: Item quantities are based on the actual requirements of the Bundles—if 99 stones are needed, sell 99.

- Once a Day: Uses the same random source as the shop system; regardless of how many times the shop is opened and closed within the same day, the items and quantities remain consistent.

- No Duplicates: Items already on the vanilla shelves will not be added again.

- Configurable: One-click toggle in config.json or the Generic Mod Config Menu.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8]- Stardew Valley 1.6+

- SMAPI 4.0+[/color]
